name: Structure for Jira
description: Structure for Jira is Tempo's portfolio and project-management app for organizing Jira work into flexible cross-project hierarchies, spreadsheet-like views and real-time reports. Teams use structures and views to coordinate portfolios, releases, backlogs and delivery plans without changing the underlying Jira work model.
agentUseSummary: Connect an expiring user-owned Structure Cloud personal access token in its exact Americas or Europe region. Selected agents can list and inspect bounded structures and views and create one empty private structure under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions; sharing, generators, JQL, hierarchy writes, administration, Data Center APIs and raw calls remain unavailable.

credentialRequirements.name: STRUCTURE_FOR_JIRA_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Structure Cloud personal access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: An expiring Structure Cloud personal access token created by the intended Jira user.

capabilities.label: Read structures
capabilities.description: List bounded structure summaries and inspect one exact structure.

capabilities.label: Read views
capabilities.description: List bounded view summaries and inspect one exact view's bounded layout metadata.

capabilities.label: Create private structures
capabilities.description: Create one empty private structure without generators or sharing.

approvalRequired.label: List structures
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty bounded Structure Cloud structure summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read structure
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded metadata for one exact numeric Structure Cloud structure ID.

approvalRequired.label: Create private structure
approvalRequired.description: Create one empty private structure without generators, Jira queries or sharing.

approvalRequired.label: List views
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty bounded Structure Cloud view summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read view
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded layout metadata for one exact Structure Cloud view UUID.

blocked.label: Change sharing or ownership
blocked.description: Permissions, sharing, owners, bulk owner changes and administrative access are unavailable.

blocked.label: Configure generators
blocked.description: JQL, inserters, extenders, sorters, groups, filters and other generators are unavailable.

blocked.label: Create or change views
blocked.description: View creation, columns, formulas, flex fields, default-view changes and view mutation are unavailable.

blocked.label: Change hierarchy content
blocked.description: Rows, Jira work items, folders, forests, hierarchy mutations and broader Jira APIs are unavailable.

blocked.label: Use Data Center APIs
blocked.description: Structure Data Center's separate instance-local and version-sensitive APIs are outside this Cloud connection.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary Structure calls
blocked.description: Agents cannot choose API origins, paths, offsets, query filters, request bodies or raw API operations.

blocked.label: Export Structure data
blocked.description: Twenty-row lists, one exact resource, twenty view column keys and 256 KiB responses are the maximum supported surface.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Private reads and private structure creation require approval. Fixed origins, bounds, token authority and audits always apply.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All five selected Structure Cloud actions run without Relay per-action approval; fixed regional origin, token authority, bounds, redaction and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway executes five fixed Structure Cloud structure/view actions at the selected documented regional origin with bounds and redaction.

providerSetup.blocker: The intended Structure Cloud user must create an expiring personal access token in Structure personal settings and confirm whether the tenant data is in the Americas or Europe region through the separate provider-console acceptance task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console acceptance task, create a short-lived least-authority Structure Cloud personal access token for a synthetic staging user, confirm the exact region, enter both values in Relay, and verify the five bounded tools before rotating or revoking the token.

evidence.supports: Tempo documents the two fixed Structure Cloud regional API origins and expiring user-created personal access tokens sent as Bearer credentials.
The official Structure Cloud API 1.1 reference documents typed structure and view endpoints, REST semantics, pagination, response schemas and a 600-request-per-minute rate limit.
Tempo describes Structure PPM as a Jira-native cross-project portfolio, hierarchy and reporting product.
Tempo documents Data Center as a distinct instance-local API with version 2 instability; Relay excludes that separate authority from the Cloud connection.
